requirements_summary: SMB support SaaS wants hosted_api for chat/support agent. Key must-haves: streaming token-by-token responses that can be reliably reassembled into valid JSON or use an explicit delimiter strategy; function/tool-calling that strictly adheres to declared JSON schema types; short latency but cost-sensitive; public cloud only; SOC2 audit on roadmap. technical_notes: Observed issues: 1) JSON mode streaming yields chunks with broken object boundaries — client needs streaming-aware parser or delimiter approach. 2) Function schema mismatch examples: numeric fields sent as strings; enums returned with unexpected casing. 3) Potential mitigation: server-side schema validation (JSON Schema), resilient streaming patterns (buffer until full object, use \u0000 delimiter), model temperature and schema-enforcement recommendations. SE recommended trying Redwood 'structured-output' guidance doc + sample prompt with explicit 'return valid JSON only' guard and post-parse validator.
